title: Strength Training 4X
author: Julie
desc: Strength training 4x a week to get stronk.

ex.note:
- single leg RDL
- kickstand RDL
- landmine single leg RDL
*slow and steady otw down 
*hand w/weight is the leg that goes down
- side plank w/hip drops

- top set 1 set x 5 reps @rpe 7 w/2-3 reps in reserve 
- 2 sets x 6 reps @80-92% of top set

- DB reverse lunge 
- front foot elevated reverse lunge 
- walking lunge

- 3PT DB ROW
- chest supported row 
- single arm chest supported row 
- KB anchor row

- top set 1 set x 6 reps @roe 7 w/2-3 reps in reserve 
- 2 sets x 7 reps @80-92%
- z press for vertical press day
- BW chin up or pull ups

- DB hammer curl 
- spider curl 
- zottman curl 
- Barbell curl

Skull crusher
California press 
Tricep press down

- top set 1 x 4 reps @RPE 7 w/2-3 reps in reserve 
- 5 sets x 4 reps @80-92% of top set
- FRONT SQUAT IN EMOM FOR 7 MINS

- top set x 4 reps x @rpe 7 w/2-3 reps in reserve 
- 3 sets x 5 reps @80-92% of top set
Picky up and pouring water
